audit.whatIsWrong: Content chart reads Skill, Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench, Skill, Skill, Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench; full-layer phases carry the same sides. The packet chart is Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill.
audit.why: The packet chart matches the page's own prose exactly: whys[1] 'it's even, not favoured', whys[2] 'it stays a stalemate', whys[3] 'genuinely even through this window', whys[4] level 6 'a real all-in', whys[5] first item 'your peak window to force the kill', whys[6] 'back to even-or-worse'. Only the enum tokens are stale — the page currently hands Tahm five stages its own text says he does not win.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill.

audit.why: Spikes are right in substance: Gragas at 6 (Explosive Cask into a wall, then Body Slam) and at Riftmaker, Tahm on the Devour roam and on full build. Only the ability NAMES attached to them were wrong — see point 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: W and R are swapped across the page, and the focus ability is described as something it is not. spikes[3] says 'Tahm's R (Abyssal Dive)', wants.foe[2] says 'R (Abyssal Dive)', late says 'his W (Devour) percent-HP damage', and breakdown.cooldowns / dosFull[0].d / report[5].t all call Abyssal Dive 'His escape + shield'.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is W: 21/20/19/18/17s, 1000-1200 range, dives and KNOCKS UP — it is an engage that displaces you, not an escape. Devour is R: no cooldown, 100 mana, swallows a champion, damaging an enemy or SHIELDING an ally. The shield the page attributes to W is Thick Skin (E): free, 3-second cooldown, converts stored damage into a temporary shield — which is why 'burst when his shield is down' is unplayable advice; it is never down. Devour's text says magic damage, not percent-health, so the 'percent-HP damage ignores your HP pool' claim in late and whys[6] is unsupported. This matches the mirror audit, which re-pointed every reference to Devour (R) or Abyssal Dive (W).
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive (W) = 21s knock-up dive. Thick Skin (E) = free 3s shield off stored damage. Devour (R) = the swallow, enemy damage or ally shield, and the roam threat. Q-tongue is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s and applies An Acquired Taste; the THIRD stack is what converts the tongue from a slow into a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan'; and wants.foe[0] calls Tongue Lash's cooldown 'long'.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1. Tongue Lash is 7s at rank 1 and 5s at rank 5 — the shortest relevant cooldown in the lane, and the reason a whiffed Body Slam is fatal here: he gets two tongues inside your one E cooldown.
audit.corrected: E = 14s at rank 1; Tongue Lash = 7s at rank 1; Thick Skin = 3s and free; Abyssal Dive = 21s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that the Q stun requires three An Acquired Taste stacks.
audit.why: It changes when you may step up: at zero stacks his tongue only slows, at two it is a stun waiting to land. The mirror's own correction records the same mechanic from Tahm's side.

edits.before: As the game goes long this slides back to even and then slightly against you. Tahm is a drain-tank who out-sustains your magic DPS, and his W (Devour) percent-HP damage shrugs off your beefy frontline, while you taper into a peel/engage role rather than a 1v1 carry. You won't kill a full-build Tahm in a sidelane, so stop trying. Use Explosive Cask to knock him off your carries or to flip HIM into your team, and treat the lane as a hold: neither of you should be winning the 1v1 outright by 30 minutes.

edits.before: Tahm Kench is a wall, not a punching bag. Your Q (Barrel Roll) magic poke and W-empowered autos do chunk him, but his grey-health passive regenerates most of that the moment he breaks vision, so you never actually convert pokes into a lead. Do not throw E-Body Slam in to open a trade: eating that whiffed stun is exactly what his Q-tongue punishes, and with your only hard CC down he can slow-stun you and walk you down. Last-hit with Barrel Roll, drink with W to clear and trigger Happy Hour to stay topped, and accept this is a stalemate by design. Don't feed him a free Q on your dash.
edits.after: Tahm Kench is a wall, not a punching bag. Your Q (Barrel Roll) magic poke and W-empowered autos do chunk him, but Thick Skin banks that damage as a free 3s shield and heals it back out of vision, so you never convert pokes into a lead. Do not throw E-Body Slam in to open a trade: a whiff is what his 7s Tongue Lash punishes, and once you carry three An Acquired Taste stacks his next tongue stuns you outright. Last-hit with Barrel Roll, drink with W to clear and trigger Happy Hour to stay topped, and accept this is a stalemate by design.

notes: The packet suspectName ('Use Explosive Cask' in late) is a FALSE POSITIVE — the name is correct, the matcher tripped on the preceding words. Real defect was a W/R swap running through the whole entry, matching what the mirror audit found from Tahm's side. Sample warning: brief.games says 487 but packet.games says 232 for the same matchup — the 49.14% win rate should be treated as soft either way, and the discrepancy is worth checking in the packet builder. Not asserted (absent from Riot's text): whether Devour can be cleansed or QSS'd, whether Explosive Cask's knockback can eject a swallowed ally, and whether Thick Skin's shield blocks the Body Slam stun component. Recorded, not written to the page.
